study.title: CWRepViT-Net: An encoder-decoder deep learning framework with RepViT blocks for crop weed semantic segmentation in soybean fields through their life journey

segmentation.domain: five-class crop/weed semantic segmentation (soil, soybean, volunteer canola, other broadleaf weeds, all grassy weeds) in soybean fields across the vegetation-to-early-reproductive growth cycle
segmentation.best_model: CWRepViT-Net: OA 0.9587, Kappa 0.91, Precision 0.9895, F1 0.9876, IoU 0.9735, 13.63 M params

dataset.name: Self-built soybean crop/weed dataset, Ian N. Morrison Research Farm, Carman, Manitoba, Canada (split-block RCBD, weedy and weed-free blocks)
dataset.note: DJI Matrice 300 RTK + Zenmuse L1 camera rig flown at 18 m; RGB orthophoto mosaics georeferenced (also noted for UAV phenotyping). Six dates in June-July 2024 (21/26/33/39/45/52 DAS; V1-R2 soybean). Sub-images 128x128 px; two ground-truth sets: GT1 (26 DAS) 947 train-val + 237 test and GT2 (45 DAS) 1094 train-val + 274 test (60/20/20 split); x4 rotation augmentation (90/180/270) -> 3788 / 4376 augmented train-val patches. QGIS polygon annotation (5 classes).

segmentation.backbone: RepViT encoder (ImageNet pre-trained, Semi-Transfer Learning) + MUNet decoder blocks concatenated at 5 resolutions (stem + 4 stages); focal loss (gamma=2)

mIoU.ambiguity: Mean-per-class IoU not explicitly reported; Table 1 reports a single overall 'IoU (%) 97.35' computed from TP/FP/FN (Eq. 4).

F1.ambiguity: Global F1-score 98.76% (model-level, pooled over classes). Baselines: MobileNetV3 98.47, MobileViT 98.05, TinyNet 97.88, TinyViT 98.01. Ablation S#3 (plain U-Net) 90.01.

PA.quote: The CWRepViT-Net model achieved an overall accuracy of over 95% and a Kappa coefficient of 0.91 ... proposed network achieved an OA of 95.87 % and a KC of 0.91
PA.ambiguity: Overall Accuracy 95.87% (global pixel accuracy, Eq. 5). Baselines: MobileNetV3 94.11, MobileViT 92.65, TinyNet 91.77, TinyViT 92.20.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed classes (volunteer canola, broadleaf, grassy) segmented but per-class F1 not reported (only global F1/IoU).

crop_F1.ambiguity: Per-class F1 for soybean not reported (only global F1/IoU).

edge.framework: TensorFlow 2.10.1, Python 3.9.21, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 + Intel i7-14700 + 64 GB RAM; Adam lr 1e-4 decay 1e-6, batch 16, 100 epochs; focal loss

fps.ambiguity: No inference latency/FPS reported; only training time (33 min 10 s, Table 1).

params_M.quote: RepViT architecture blocks with approximately 15 million (15 M) parameters ... Parameters (Million) ... CWRepViT-Net (Proposed method)  14.23  13.63
params_M.section: 3.4 CWRepViT-Net architecture / 4.3 Comparison of experimental results
params_M.ambiguity: 13.63 M params in encoder-decoder form (14.23 M original RepViT form; Table 1 distinguishes 'original form / encoder-decoder form'). Compared: MobileNetV3 6.5, MobileViT 9.7, TinyNet 7.2, TinyViT 11.2 (encoder-decoder forms).

issues: No inference-time or edge benchmarks; only training efficiency discussed (Semi-TL, 33 min 10 s training) - edge.reported=false.
IoU 97.35% reported as a single overall metric (Eq. 4), not mean-per-class mIoU.
Per-class evaluation via confusion matrices is qualitative in text; numeric per-class accuracies in Fig. 8 (>90% for most classes) not tabulated.
GSD not reported (18 m altitude, M300 RTK/Zenmuse L1); 128x128 patches from orthophoto mosaics across 6 dates.
